Definition: Jether, the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite
BiblicalUsage: Jether is the name of five or six Israelites and of one Midianite. In Exodus 4:18, Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law. The fuller story is told on the Jether, Father of Amasa profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jether belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
